# The commands each required job exists to run, by workflow and job, one a line as
# `<workflow file>#<job id>: <text of the command>`. The workflow policy test
# (.github/scripts/policy.test.mjs) requires each in a run: step of its job that runs whenever the
# job does, with no condition in a job without a watch and with the watch's own in an instrument
# job, and that may not fail quietly: deleting the step, skipping it or letting it continue on error
# fails the policy. Every job that builds in release proves its overflow checks. A job's every
# required check is named in .github/required-checks.txt, and every required job is named here.

ci.yml#rust: cargo test --locked
ci.yml#rust: cargo test --locked -p mente-cli --test gates
ci.yml#rust: cargo run --locked --bin mn -- spec
ci.yml#rust: cargo run --locked --bin mn -- test --mutate
ci.yml#rust: cargo run --locked --bin mn -- view --spec examples/02_mechanical_sympathy_simd.mn
ci.yml#bench: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
ci.yml#bench: MENTE_BENCH_ENFORCE=1
ci.yml#execution-paths: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
ci.yml#execution-paths: cargo test --release --locked -p mente-cli -- --ignored matches_the_reference_interpreter
ci.yml#debuggers: bash compiler/mente-cli/tests/debuggers/check.sh target/debug/mn
ci.yml#tier1-latency: MENTE_BENCH_ENFORCE=1 cargo test --release --locked -p mente-cli -- --ignored --nocapture tier1_recheck_protocol
ci.yml#tier1-latency: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
ci.yml#docs: node --test .github/scripts/policy.test.mjs .github/scripts/yaml.test.mjs
ci.yml#docs: npm run verify:docs
ci.yml#docs: "$RUNNER_TEMP/lint/actionlint" -color -shellcheck
ci.yml#docs: npm run check:benchmark
ci.yml#docs: npm run test:benchmark
ci.yml#docs: npm run test:harness

commits.yml#commits: node .github/scripts/commits.mjs

mutants.yml#in-diff: cargo mutants --in-diff pr.diff --shard "$SHARD/4" --in-place
mutants.yml#in-diff: node .github/scripts/mutants-floor.mjs missing

generated.yml#paths: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
generated.yml#paths: generated_programs_run_alike_on_the_three_paths
generated.yml#paths: conformance_programs_run_alike_on_the_three_paths

smt.yml#z3: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
smt.yml#z3: ./target/release/mn smt examples
smt.yml#z3: bash -c 'check "$1"'

fuzz.yml#fuzz: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
fuzz.yml#fuzz: target/release/mn fuzz --seed

mir-mutants.yml#gate: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
mir-mutants.yml#gate: ./target/release/mn test --mutate --reported examples

perf.yml#kernels: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
perf.yml#kernels: node --test perf/run.test.mjs
perf.yml#kernels: node perf/run.mjs --mn

harness.yml#fixtures: bash .github/scripts/overflow-proof.sh
harness.yml#fixtures: node benchmark/harness/fixtures.ts --languages mente,rust,odin
harness.yml#fixtures: node benchmark/harness/fixtures.ts --check document
harness.yml#fixtures: node benchmark/harness/sandbox-check.ts
harness.yml#fixtures: npm run test:harness
